name: CUREVANTA
summary: Monochrome multi-specialty clinic site: black, white and warm mist grey, inset photo hero with a glass stats panel, tidy numbered cards and plus-icon pill buttons.

fonts.pairing: Inter Display 500 with tight negative tracking for headings and stats, Inter for body, small caps eyebrows in pills

signature: inset rounded photo hero with floating dark glass nav bar and a translucent stats panel bottom right
pill buttons ending in a round plus disc
black rating bar with a giant 4.9/5 under the review cards
small numbered chips sitting on card photo corners
imagery: bright clinical stock photography of clinicians, families and labs, natural light, full colour against a colourless UI
layout_grid: 1104px content, 48px side padding, 112px section padding, 12px gutter for full-width dark cards, 3 and 4 column card grids
